text: As artificial intelligence becomes more common in daily life, questions about its impact on society grow. One major concern is bias, where AI systems may unfairly treat certain groups due to the data they were trained on. This raises important issues of fairness and equality. Additionally, privacy is at risk when AI systems collect and analyze vast amounts of personal information without clear consent. To build trust, transparency is essential—people need to know how decisions are made by these systems. Responsible AI development involves designing technology that respects human rights and prioritizes safety. Ultimately, building AI ethically is not just a technical challenge but a moral one.
